data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 asserts a contradiction relation by claiming SRC_006 'internally discovers it yields $909 ... not $855' and that this 'exposes a self-contradiction.' But the target presupposes $855 is the correct figure without ever establishing or inheriting a causal mechanism that produces $855. The standard piecewise overtime calculation (40×18 + 7×27) actually yields $909, not $855. Thus the 'self-contradiction' is an artifact of the critic's own false premise: there is no contradiction if $909 is the correct result of the standard method. The target inherits and propagates a non-existent error, naming it 'double-counted base pay' when in fact the premium-only method is algebraically equivalent to the correct standard method.
